results.title: Polish PM Donald Tusk Pays Tribute to Mahatma Gandhi
results.description: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk paid floral tributes to Mahatma Gandhi at Rajghat in New Delhi, honouring the global legacy of peace and non-violence.

results.title: Texas 2024 General Election: Key Races and Voting Information
results.description: Election Day is Tuesday, Nov. 3, with polls open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Early voting runs from Oct. 19 to Oct. 30. Voters in Tarrant County will decide on critical races for the Texas State Board of Education, State Senate, and the judiciary, including the Supreme Court and Criminal Appeals Court. This guide lists all 2024 midterm contests, including candidate names and party affiliations, as provided by the Tarrant County election website.
